title: Lead Prioritization
description: Rank a list of prospects by a weighted score across fit, intent, and engagement so you always work the best opportunities first.

children.text: Rank prospects by a weighted score so you always work the best opportunities first.

Three dimensions, weighted by predictive value:

| Dimension | Weight | What It Measures |
|-----------|--------|-----------------|
| Fit | 30% | How well they match the ideal customer profile |
| Intent | 40% | How ready they are to move (strongest predictor) |
| Engagement | 30% | How active they have been with your outreach |

### Fit Scoring (0-10)
- 9-10: Perfect match, right profile, background, and goals
- 6-8: Good fit with minor gaps
- 3-5: Marginal fit
- 0-2: Poor fit

### Intent Scoring (0-10)
- 9-10: Active trigger present (deadline imminent, recent reply, reactivation date reached)
- 6-8: Engaged recently, no strong trigger
- 3-5: Showed interest but has gone cold
- 0-2: No engagement signals

### Engagement Scoring (0-10)
- 9-10: Recent reply or multi-open email activity
- 6-8: Some opens, no replies
- 3-5: Opened once or twice, long ago
- 0-2: No opens
From the input provided, score each prospect on all three dimensions. Calculate the weighted total and rank highest to lowest.

```
# Lead Priority List, [Date]

| Rank | Prospect | Fit | Intent | Engagement | Score | Next Action |
|------|----------|-----|--------|------------|-------|-------------|
| 1 | [name] | [n] | [n] | [n] | [weighted] | [action] |
| 2 | ... | | | | | |

## Top 5, Work These Today
[Brief note on each: why they scored high and the specific next action]

## Watch List, Check Back This Week
[Prospects just below threshold who could move up]
```
